description: This is an ASP.NET Core Web API controller class, CustomersController, which handles HTTP requests related to customer management actions such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting customers. It uses MediatR for CQRS pattern implementation, by sending various commands and queries via the _mediator object.

classes.name: CustomersController
classes.description: API controller managing customer-related endpoints such as listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting customers. Implements typical RESTful actions using MediatR for CQRS.

methods.name: GetCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list customers with optional search, pagination, and returns a paged response.

methods.name: GetCustomerById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific customer by their GUID.

methods.name: CreateCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer and returns the created customer with 201 status.

methods.name: UpdateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing customer by GUID.

methods.name: DeleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer by GUID.
